description: An image's bytes and what was derived from them, kept beside the documents that show it. A picture can appear in many documents and locales; its palette and its placeholder are facts about the picture, not about any one page, so they rest here once — keyed by nothing but the record's own rkey — and an image value points at this record instead of repeating them. Derived data is also the part most likely to be recomputed, and a sidecar can be rewritten without touching a document.

ref.description: The bytes. Held here so the PDS keeps them alive for as long as the record does.

dominantColor.description: The colour the box behind the image is painted with, before the bytes arrive.

palette.description: The palette extractor's swatches, as hex.

variants.description: The resized copies a `srcset` chooses from, smallest first.

url.description: Where the copy is served from, when it is not a blob on this repo.
